Always conform to the coding styles defined below:

- This is an app divided into 3 parts: a Nuxt 3 app, a Node.js backend, and a Python inference server.
- The Nuxt 3 app is the frontend, the Node.js backend handles API requests, and the Python inference server runs the image detection model.
- Always use a 4 space indent.
- Always use arrow functions instead of function declarations.
- Always use `const` or `let` instead of `var`.
- Always use template literals instead of string concatenation.
- Always put the Nuxt script setup block at the top of the file.
- Always use `async/await` for asynchronous code instead of `.then()`.
- Always use `import` instead of `require`.
- If you can, always use `import` at the top of the file.
- If a method has only one parameter, don't use parentheses.
- DO NOT REMOVE any comments when you edit the code!
- Always add the semicolon at the end of the line when needed.
